hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT   ar_code as areacode,   ar_name as areamame,   SUM(result1) as result1,   SUM(result2) as result2,   SUM(result3) as result3,   SUM(result4) as result4 FROM   {{S_TABLE}}   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT       hoscode as ar_code,       hosname as ar_name,       chospital_regis.*     FROM       chospital_regis   ) chospital_regis ON chospital_regis.hoscode = {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode   INNER JOIN (     SELECT       hcode as hospcode,       hcode,       splevel,       bed,       bedhos     FROM       ccmihosp       INNER JOIN chospital_regis h ON ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode     WHERE       byear = SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)       AND ( splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}       )       AND ( ccmihosp.region = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}       )       AND ( ccmihosp.chwcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}       )     GROUP BY       hcode   ) sp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = sp.hospcode WHERE   {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}}   AND LEFT ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99')   AND b_year IN (     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)   )   AND chospital_regis.hdc_regist = 1   AND (     {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}     or 'ALL' = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}   )   AND (amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL')   AND (dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL') GROUP BY   ar_code ORDER BY

moo.label: หมู่บ้าน
moo.query: SELECT   ar_code as areacode,   ar_name as areamame,   SUM(result1) as result1,   SUM(result2) as result2,   SUM(result3) as result3,   SUM(result4) as result4 FROM   {{S_TABLE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}}   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT       villagecodefull as ar_code,       villagename as ar_name,       villagecodefull as l_code     FROM       cvillage     GROUP BY       l_code     ORDER BY       l_code   ) as ar ON left ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 8) = ar.l_code   LEFT JOIN chospital_regis ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = chospital_regis.hoscode WHERE   {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}}   AND LEFT ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99')   AND b_year IN (     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)   )   AND (     left (areacode, 6) = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}     or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}   )   AND (zone_code = ({{ZONE_CODE}}) or {{ZONE_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})   AND (dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL')   AND (dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND ({{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL') GROUP BY   ar_code

province_ampur.label: จังหวัด + อำเภอ
province_ampur.query: SELECT   ar_code as areacode,   ar_name as areamame,   SUM(result1) as result1,   SUM(result2) as result2,   SUM(result3) as result3,   SUM(result4) as result4 FROM   {{S_TABLE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}}   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT       ampurcodefull as ar_code,       concat ( cw.changwatcode, ':', cw.changwatname, ' - ', a.ampurcodefull, ':', a.ampurname       ) as ar_name,       ampurcodefull as l_code     FROM       campur AS a       INNER JOIN cchangwat cw ON a.changwatcode = cw.changwatcode     WHERE       zonecode not in ('99')     GROUP BY       l_code     ORDER BY       l_code   ) as ar ON left ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 4) = ar.l_code   LEFT JOIN chospital_regis ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = chospital_regis.hoscode WHERE   {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}}   AND LEFT ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99')   AND b_year IN (     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)   )   AND (zone_code = ({{ZONE_CODE}}) or {{ZONE_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})   AND (dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL')   AND (dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND ({{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL') GROUP BY   ar_code

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT   ar_code as areacode,   ar_name as areamame,   SUM(result1) as result1,   SUM(result2) as result2,   SUM(result3) as result3,   SUM(result4) as result4 FROM   {{S_TABLE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}}   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT       z.zonecode as ar_code,       zonename as ar_name,       changwatcode as l_code     FROM       cchangwat c       INNER JOIN czone z ON c.zonecode = z.zonecode     WHERE       c.zonecode not in ('99')     GROUP BY       l_code     ORDER BY       l_code   ) as ar ON left ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) = ar.l_code   LEFT JOIN chospital_regis ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = chospital_regis.hoscode   INNER JOIN (     SELECT       hoscode as hcode     FROM       chospital_regis       INNER JOIN cchangwat ON chospital_regis.provcode = cchangwat.changwatcode     WHERE       chospital_regis.hdc_regist = 1       AND chospital_regis.status = '1'     GROUP BY       hoscode   ) sp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = sp.hcode WHERE   {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}}   AND LEFT ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99')   AND b_year IN (     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)   )   AND (zone_code = ({{ZONE_CODE}}) or {{ZONE_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})   AND (dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL')   AND (dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND ({{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL') GROUP BY   ar_code

province_ampur.label: จังหวัด + อำเภอ
province_ampur.query: SELECT   ar_code as areacode,   ar_name as areamame,   SUM(result1) as result1,   SUM(result2) as result2,   SUM(result3) as result3,   SUM(result4) as result4 FROM   {{S_TABLE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}}   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT       ampurcodefull as ar_code,       concat ( cw.changwatcode, ':', cw.changwatname, ' - ', a.ampurcodefull, ':', a.ampurname       ) as ar_name,       ampurcodefull as l_code     FROM       campur AS a       INNER JOIN cchangwat cw ON a.changwatcode = cw.changwatcode     WHERE       zonecode not in ('99')     GROUP BY       l_code     ORDER BY       l_code   ) as ar ON left ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 4) = ar.l_code   LEFT JOIN chospital ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = chospital.hoscode WHERE   {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}}   AND LEFT ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99')   AND b_year IN (     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)   )   AND (zone_code = ({{ZONE_CODE}}) or {{ZONE_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})   AND (dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL')   AND (dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND ({{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL') GROUP BY   ar_code

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT   ar_code as areacode,   ar_name as areamame,   SUM(result1) as result1,   SUM(result2) as result2,   SUM(result3) as result3,   SUM(result4) as result4 FROM   {{S_TABLE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}}   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT       z.zonecode as ar_code,       zonename as ar_name,       changwatcode as l_code     FROM       cchangwat c       INNER JOIN czone z ON c.zonecode = z.zonecode     WHERE       c.zonecode not in ('99')     GROUP BY       l_code     ORDER BY       l_code   ) as ar ON left ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) = ar.l_code   LEFT JOIN chospital ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = chospital.hoscode   INNER JOIN (     SELECT       hoscode as hcode     FROM       chospital       INNER JOIN cchangwat ON chospital.provcode = cchangwat.changwatcode     WHERE       chospital.hdc_regist = 1       AND chospital.status = '1'     GROUP BY       hoscode   ) sp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = sp.hcode WHERE   {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}}   AND LEFT ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99')   AND b_year IN (     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)   )   AND (zone_code = ({{ZONE_CODE}}) or {{ZONE_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})   AND (dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL')   AND (dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND ({{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL') GROUP BY   ar_code

provider.query: SELECT   sp.hcode as areacode,   ar_name as areamame,   SUM(result1) as result1,   SUM(result2) as result2,   SUM(result3) as result3,   SUM(result4) as result4 FROM   {{S_TABLE}}   LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}}   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT       changwatcode as ar_code,       changwatname as ar_name,       changwatcode as l_code     FROM       cchangwat     WHERE       ( zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}       )     GROUP BY       l_code     ORDER BY       l_code   ) as ar ON left ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) = ar.l_code   LEFT JOIN chospital ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = chospital.hoscode   INNER JOIN (     SELECT       hoscode as hcode     FROM       chospital       INNER JOIN cchangwat ON chospital.provcode = cchangwat.changwatcode     WHERE       chospital.hdc_regist = 1       AND chospital.status = '1'       AND ( zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}       )     GROUP BY       hoscode   ) sp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = sp.hcode WHERE   {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}}   AND LEFT ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99')   AND b_year IN (     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)   )   AND (chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})   AND (dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL')   AND (dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND ({{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL') GROUP BY   sp.hcode

cup.label: เครือข่ายบริการสุขภาพ
cup.query: SELECT   ar_code as areacode,   ar_name as areamame,   SUM(result1) as result1,   SUM(result2) as result2,   SUM(result3) as result3,   SUM(result4) as result4 FROM   {{S_TABLE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}}   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT       hoscode as ar_code,       hosname as ar_name,       chospital.*     FROM       chospital   ) chospital ON chospital.hoscode = {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode   INNER JOIN cmastercup ON chospital.hoscode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE   {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}}   AND LEFT ({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99')   AND b_year IN (     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),     SUBSTRING_INDEX ({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)   )   AND (     chospital.provcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}     or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}   )    AND (zone_code = ({{ZONE_CODE}}) or {{ZONE_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND ( cmastercup.hmain = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} OR {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL' )   AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})   AND (dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL')   AND (dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL')   AND (mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL') GROUP BY   ar_code
